ms.report:
Note to reviewers: Please see our comments in the Discussion tab, where we clarified how the original submission already addressed several of the requested items (team roles, Learn-to-Work cycle definitions, project timeline, and engagement metrics). The documents below incorporate the additional approval evidence and version metadata requested in the review feedback.
This resubmission of Milestone 1 includes remediated documents. I updated all four deliverables to add version metadata (version number, date, remediation status) and a formal Document Approval section. All three Barça Vision review committee members (Jordi Mompart, Anna Soler, Lucia Matamoros) signed off on 2026-02-10. The original submission met each acceptance criterion; these amendments provide the requested evidence of approval and version traceability.
A. Output: Team Document (v0.2, Remediated). The document defines the project roles, responsibilities, and governance structure for both the Andamio and Barça Vision teams, including communication channels and decision-making processes. Acceptance criteria: The Team Document lists eight members, their roles, project management processes, and communication workflows.
How the criteria are met: The document lists 11 named team members across two organizations (4 from Barça Vision, 7 from Andamio), each with named roles, positions, and detailed responsibilities (Sections 3.1 and 3.2). Section 4 defines communication protocols, channels, and meeting cadence. Section 5.1 (Decision-Making Authority) explicitly names Jordi Mompart as the strategic approval authority and Anna Soler as the operational approval authority, and states that all strategic decisions require Jordi Mompart's sign-off, while all operational implementation decisions require Anna Soler's approval. The document header includes version metadata (v0.2, date, remediation status). Section 9 (Formal Document Approval) records sign-off by Anna Soler, Jordi Mompart, and Lucia Matamoros on 2026

ms.criteria:
On Onboarding:
Our acceptance criteria state that 80% of the Barça Vision team will complete onboarding within two weeks. This is achieved through a one‐hour training session—we will AI summary + screenshots and we can share the recording with the Catalyst Team —that covers all key features of Andamio. The Barça Vision team is clearly defined in our proposal, and we maintain constant communication with them to ensure a smooth process. Regarding the three training sessions mentioned in the milestone outputs (which are not included in the original proposal), they are designed to be complementary
ms.report:
Milestone 2 Report

Project: FC Barcelona — Fan engagement infrastructure Cardano Milestone: M2 — Platform Setup
A. Output: Onboarding of the Barça Vision team — four complementary training sessions covering Andamio features and workflows. (The milestone outputs specify three sessions; four were delivered to provide broader coverage, each addressing a different aspect of the platform rather than repeating material.)
Acceptance criteria: 80% of the Barça Vision team completes onboarding within two weeks, achieved through training sessions covering all key features of Andamio. Evidence is provided as AI-generated meeting summaries and screenshots per session. Full session recordings are not shared publicly because they contain proprietary information; they can be made available to the Catalyst Team on request.
Evidence: https://github.com/Andamio-Platform/fcb-fan-engagement-public-reporting/tree/main/evidence/A-onboarding-training — four session screenshots and four Barça Vision-reviewed AI notes (filenames marked _revised reflect BV edits to the AI-generated text). Approval of these notes and screenshots is recorded in the M2 closing email from Barça Vision: https://github.com/Andamio-Platform/fcb-fan-engagement-public-reporting/blob/main/evidence/M2-Sign-off-email-BV-2026-05-14.pdf
B. Output: Learn-to-Work Program outline covering four cycles, each documenting objectives, estimated duration, and target skills:
・Cycle 1 — Introduction & Community Onboarding
・Cycle 2 — Participation & Engagement Foundations
・Cycle 3 — Applied Contribution Skills
・Cycle 4 — Leadership & Advanced Contribution

Acceptance criteria: Each of the four cycles includes a clear outline with objectives, duration, and target skills. Content quality is reviewed by the Barça Vision team to ensure suitability for the FC Barcelona brand.
